description: Mainnet accounts, programs and transactions dumped for the program tests (ARCHITECTURE §1.2, §8.2). Each entry records how it was fetched; SHA256SUMS pins the bytes (CI: cd tests/fixtures && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS). The Raydium entries (groups raydium_programs and raydium_state) and the pump entries (groups pump_programs and pump_state) are written by scripts/dump-fixtures.py; `snapshots` records the slot and RPC of each group.
